p106.lead: From the incomplete finite to infinity: the paper that shows how the seven levels of reality and the three Trinities are being integrated, and whom we meet at the end of the road.

p106.foot.text: Presented by a Melchizedek of Nebadon

p106.s0.b0: If Paper 105 dealt with the origins of reality, Paper 106 deals with how that reality is being integrated. Its author, a Melchizedek of Nebadon, says that ascending mortals must understand not only Deity’s relation to the universe but also the relationships between themselves and the many levels of reality. Such understanding enhances both our terrestrial orientation and our spiritual directionization.

p106.s0.b2: The author insists that these categories are convenient compromise symbols for the present age and for the mortal perspective. They are limited by mortal language and mind, by the incomplete development of the superuniverses, by our ignorance of the other purposes of superuniverse development, and by our lack of an eternity viewpoint. And reality itself grows from age to age.
p106.s1.h: I. Primary Association of Finite Functionals — God the Sevenfold
p106.s1.b0: The primary phases of finite reality find immediate expression in the perfect Havona creation, but the evolutionary, secondary phases become integrated only through growth and attainment. Between the two lies the superuniverse time lag. The text says this lag is an obstacle, and at the same time an opportunity for the creature to become the Creator’s partner in its own evolution.
p106.s1.b2: God the Sevenfold signifies Paradise Deity’s recognition of the barriers of time in the evolutionary universes. Because we ascend by personal and spiritual progress, it is the personal and spiritual divinity of the Sevenfold Deity that we find. The Sevenfold is the source of the relative unity of functional reality in the present grand universe, and all its phases are destined to be unified in the Supreme.
p106.s2.h: II. Secondary Supreme Finite Integration — The Supreme Being
p106.s2.b0: As God the Sevenfold functionally co-ordinates finite evolution, so the Supreme Being synthesizes destiny attainment. The concept of the Supreme must distinguish spirit person, evolutionary power, and the power-personality synthesis of the two. Spirit comes from Paradise through Havona; energy-matter evolves in the depths of space and is organized as power by the Creator Sons and the children of the Infinite Spirit.
p106.s2.b1: This experiential power is earned and demonstrated power, in contrast to the existential power of the Paradise Deities. As it unites with the spirit personality of God the Supreme on the outer belt of Havona, the power product of time and space is invested with personality. Since mortals too are personal participants in this majestic transaction, they gain the capacity to know the Supreme and to perceive themselves as his true children.
p106.s2.b3: Just as Michael is like the Father because he shares his Paradise perfection, evolutionary mortals will one day share the evolutionary perfection of the Supreme. The seven Absolutes cannot be known by experience, but the personality realities of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit can be grasped in the attitude of prayer and worship.
p106.s3.h: III–VI. The Experiential Trinities — From the Ultimate to the Absolute
p106.s3.b0: The absonite architects eventuate the plan, the Supreme Creators bring it into existence, and the Supreme Being will consummate its fullness. When the present universe age ends and the Almighty Supreme appears, the first experiential Trinity, the Trinity Ultimate, will function completely. Because the Master Creator Sons are among its members, genuine creature experience is part of this Trinity.

p106.s3.b3: The Trinity Ultimate co-ordinates the master creation, while God the Ultimate is the transcendental power-personalization that gives direction to the whole master universe. As the Supreme is now spiritually and personally present in Havona, so is the Ultimate present there in an absonite sense. What the full emergence of the Ultimate will change, we do not yet know.
p106.s3.b4: The Trinity Absolute can be fully formed only after the whole master universe, from Havona to the outermost space level, has been completed. Its full function seems to imply a cosmos-infinite beyond even the master universe. At this point the text restates what a trinity really is.
p106.s3.b6: Trinities are not personal, yet they do not contravene personality; they encompass it. Only the deified can become trinity, so the association of the three Absolutes is not a trinity but a triunity or triodity. The eternity action of the Trinity Absolute suggests the personalization of the Deity Absolute—the completion of God the Absolute, the third and last of the experiential Deities.
p106.s4.h: VII. Finality of Destiny — A Journey Without End
p106.s4.b0: Infinite integration is hard to imagine because it presupposes the experiential realization of all that could ever be. In the three potential Absolutes there always remain possibilities that no amount of experience can exhaust. Every being and every universe has a final destiny of absolute value, yet no being will ever completely attain all of its aspects.
p106.s4.b2: The text stresses, however, that this is no cause for discouragement. We really can attain the Deity levels of the Sevenfold, the Supreme, and the Ultimate. The infinity of God is, in fact, the supreme assurance that throughout endless futurity the possibilities of personality growth and Deity association will never be exhausted.
p106.s5.b0: In the mechanisms, personalities, and associations of the three Trinities, the author detects the theoretical possibility that the seven absolute phases of the Father-I AM might be reunited. This is the Trinity of Trinities, in which the experiential infinite becomes one with the existential infinite. The text portrays it as three levels of increasing unification.

p106.s5.b2: The identity of the third member of the second level is the least clear; the text says it is least distorting to think of it as the Universal Absolute. The personal union of this second level has already appeared in our universe age in the deitization of Majeston. The text also traces the completion of the cycle of reality, as the Father-Son partnership becomes Son-Spirit, then Spirit-Supreme, and on to the Father-Infinite.
p106.s5.b4: The I AM of past eternity is alone. The I AM of future eternity is existentially unchanged but experientially very different. The difference is that limitless galaxy of personalities who have taken part, by their own will, in his self-revelation. They remain forever as volitional parts of the totality of infinity—final sons of the absolute Father.
p106.s6.h: IX. Existential Infinite Unification — Unity at This Very Moment
p106.s6.b0: Experiential integration lies in the remote future, but the existential unification of infinity exists right now in the Paradise Trinity. Time, space, and experience are the tools by which creatures grasp relative reality, and at the same time the barriers to complete perception. On the absolute level there is neither time nor space.
p106.s6.b3: How, then, can the viewpoint of time and the viewpoint of eternity be reconciled? The author suggests that we accept the Paradise Trinity as the existential unification of infinity, and he gives three reasons why we cannot detect the completed manifestation of the Trinity of Trinities.

p106.s6.b5: The solitary I AM of the past and the attainable I AM of the future are therefore one and the same hypothesis. No change has taken place in the Infinite; it is our capacity to receive reality that grows. And this lofty discussion arrives at a surprisingly concrete conclusion: all creature growth is proportional to Father identification, and to live divinely is to live the will of God.
p106.s7.b0: Paper 106 climbs through the seven levels of reality and the three Trinities all the way to infinity, and then, at the end, comes back down to the ground of our daily lives. A life built on the Father’s will is predicated on truth, sensitive to beauty, and dominated by goodness. Such a person is inwardly illuminated by worship and outwardly devoted to a service motivated by love.

p106.s7.b2: The next paper, Paper 107, “Origin and Nature of Thought Adjusters,” turns our attention to how this infinite Father dwells within our very minds—the story of the Adjusters.
p107.lead: A fragment of God dwelling in the mortal mind: where Thought Adjusters come from, how they are classified, and what they are made of.

p107.foot.text: Presented by a Solitary Messenger of Orvonton

p107.s0.h: Introduction — The Father Who Is Farthest and Nearest
p107.s0.b0: With Paper 107 a series of papers on the Thought Adjusters begins. The author, a Solitary Messenger of Orvonton, opens with a paradox. The Universal Father resides on Paradise at the center of all things, yet he is actually present on the worlds of space, in the minds of his children of time, as the Mystery Monitors. The One who is farthest removed is at the same time the most intimately near.
p107.s0.b2: God commanded us to be perfect as he is perfect, and then came down himself as the partner who helps us fulfill that command. So any mortal who follows the leading of the Adjuster, consciously or unconsciously, is already living by the will of God. The unquenchable longing to be like God is itself something the Adjuster creates in us.
p107.s0.b4: At the end of the opening, the author adds that the Monitors are called by different names at different stages of mortal life. He makes it clear, however, that this division has nothing to do with the three stages of Adjuster progress in mind duplication and soul evolution.

p107.s1.h: I. Origin of Thought Adjusters — God from God
p107.s1.b0: The author begins humbly: no one may speak with authority about the nature and origin of Adjusters. All he can offer are the traditions of Salvington and the beliefs of Uversa. On their origin, however, there is no disagreement. Adjusters are not created beings; they are fragmentized entities of the infinite God, proceeding directly from the First Source and Center.
p107.s1.b2: When Adjusters began their separate existence, and how many there are, is not known. It is presumed that they are constantly being individualized as the universe enlarges and fusion candidates increase, though perhaps even trying to count them is a mistake. The technique of their origin is an unrevealed function of the Father, and none of his other absolute associates seem to have any part in it.
p107.s1.b3: The section closes by comparing the ways in which the three persons of Deity give themselves to mortals. Because the nature of the Eternal Son cannot be fragmented in this way, there are three series of fusion.

p107.s2.h: II. Classification of Adjusters — Seven Orders
p107.s2.b0: Adjusters are individuated as virgin entities, and all are destined to become liberated, fused, or personalized. The author lists seven orders while admitting that he does not altogether comprehend these divisions. In divine nature they are all the same; the differences come from actual experience in universe ministry.

p107.s2.b2: The third order in particular gives us something to ponder. When a person rejects survival, the Adjuster’s labor is not thrown away; that experience becomes the ability to help the next mortal. Such an Adjuster is no more divine than a virgin Monitor, but it can do in the human mind what a less experienced one cannot.
p107.s2.b4: The fused Adjusters of the sixth order appear to translate from the absolute existential level of the universe to the finite experiential level. While retaining all of their existential divine nature, they become indissolubly linked with the ascending career of a surviving mortal.
p107.s3.h: III. The Divinington Home of Adjusters — The Sphere No One May Visit
p107.s3.b0: The dispatch, management, direction, and return of Adjusters all seem to be centered on Divinington, a secret sphere of Paradise. As far as the author knows, none but Adjusters and other entities of the Father have been there. When Adjusters return to the Father, they go back to Divinington and probably have actual contact with the Father’s Paradise personality.
p107.s3.b1: Beings of high spiritual orders receive only three divine injunctions. The first two concern attitudes toward those above and those below, and they translate well into our own human relationships.

p107.s3.b3: The Solitary Messenger does not complain about the prohibition. He is sure that if anything on Divinington were essential to his growth, he would not have been forbidden to go there. This attitude—reading a prohibition as grounds for trust—is also a model for anyone of faith who stands before the unknown.
p107.s3.b5: The valor and wisdom of the Adjusters suggest that they have received extensive training on Divinington. Its training schools are staffed by Personalized Adjusters, and the corps is presided over by the Personalized Adjuster of the first Paradise Michael Son to complete his sevenfold bestowal. Personalized Adjusters are always known by name, not by number.
p107.s4.h: IV. Nature and Presence of Adjusters — Qualified Absolute Fragments
p107.s4.b0: Adjusters are not absolutes in the universal sense, but they are probably true absolutes within the potentialities of their fragmented nature. They are limited in universality but not in nature. That is why the author calls them the qualified absolute fragments of the Father. Moreover, not one of them has ever been disloyal.
p107.s4.b2: Nonpersonalized Adjusters are visible only to Personalized Adjusters. Even Solitary Messengers and seraphim can only detect their presence through spiritual reactive phenomena or a spirit luminosity. This luminosity goes by different names in different places.

p107.s4.b4: The author ends the section with a question: do we truly realize what it means for an absolute fragment of infinite Deity to indwell and fuse with our finite mortal nature? No limit can ever be placed on the destiny of such a partnership. In eternity we will discover not only the infinity of the objective God but also the unending potential of the subjective fragment of God within us.
p107.s5.h: V–VI. Adjuster Mindedness; Adjusters as Pure Spirits
p107.s5.b0: We tend to think of mind as a mediator between spirit and matter. But Adjusters exist on an absolute level prior to all divergence of energy and spirit, so there is nothing for mind to mediate. Even so, Adjusters plan, work, and love, so they must possess powers commensurate with mind. Otherwise they could never be personalized.
p107.s5.b1: Even after fusion, the Adjuster’s mind remains distinct from the creature’s mind until the ascender reaches spirit levels. On the finaliter level, the mind factor that had linked the two appears to “supremacize” and augment the experiential endowment of the Supreme Being. One person’s experience, in other words, is added to the evolving God.
p107.s5.b3: The Adjuster is pure spirit, but spirit plus. Besides its conjectured mindedness, it contains factors of pure energy and traverses the grand universe instantly over the gravity circuits of Paradise. Yet it is not subject to gravity, for Adjusters are fragments of the ancestor of gravity, not its consequentials.

p107.s5.b5: The most moving passage is about the Adjuster’s love. The Adjusters truly and divinely love us; they are prisoners of spirit hope confined in human minds, longing for their loneliness to end. From the moment of their bestowal until their release at the natural death of their subjects, they have no relaxation.
p107.s6.h: VII. Adjusters and Personality — Prepersonal Beings with Volition
p107.s6.b0: Adjusters are not personalities, yet they are realities of the purest order known in the universe. How, then, can beings that are not persons select mortal subjects and volunteer to indwell them? The author candidly admits that probably no being in the universe has found the exact answer.
p107.s6.b1: Still, the Adjusters’ conduct shows genuine volition. They volunteer to indwell, lay plans for our eternal career, and adapt and modify according to circumstances. Why, then, are they subservient to the mortal will? Because their volition, though absolute in nature, is prepersonal in manifestation. They are neither subpersonal nor superpersonal; the most accurate word is prepersonal.
p107.s7.b0: Paper 107 does not hide the limits of what is known about Adjusters. It admits ignorance of the technique of their origin, of the whereabouts of the fourth order, of the nature of their will. But one thing is certain: a fragment of God himself lives within us, loves us, and waits for our choices. The paper asks how we will live with that fact.

p107.s7.b2: The next paper, Paper 108, “Mission and Ministry of Thought Adjusters,” goes on to explore how Adjusters are selected and assigned to mortals, when their indwelling begins, and what mission they carry out.
p108.lead: They volunteer, they wait for our first moral choice before they indwell, and they seek to make our lives not easy but eternal: the mission and ministry of the Thought Adjusters.

p108.foot.text: Presented by a Solitary Messenger of Orvonton

p108.s0.h: Introduction — How God Becomes Our Experiential Father
p108.s0.b0: If Paper 107 described what Adjusters are, Paper 108 describes what they do. The same Solitary Messenger of Orvonton first sums up their fundamental work: to represent, and to be, the Universal Father to the mortal creatures of time and space. The result is a unique being—the eternal union of the perfect Adjuster and the perfected creature—which could not be duplicated by any other universe technique.
p108.s0.b1: Why must God himself come down? The infinite God is infallible and all-inclusive, yet he cannot experientially know what he has never personally experienced. So the spirit of the Father descends from Paradise to take part in every genuine experience of the finite mortal’s ascending career.
p108.s0.b3: Across six sections the paper takes up the selection and assignment of Adjusters, the prerequisites of indwelling, their organization, their relation to other spiritual influences, their mission, and finally God in man. Again and again the author says “⟦Q 108:2.11⟧we do not know⟦/Q⟧,” yet on one point he is emphatic: Adjusters never fail and never falter.
p108.s1.h: I. Selection and Assignment — Volunteers Who Know Everything in Advance
p108.s1.b0: Adjusters dispatched from Divinington are identical in their endowment of divinity, but they differ according to previous experience. The more experienced Adjuster is often observed to indwell the higher type of human mind, so human inheritance seems to be a considerable factor in assignment. The Solitary Messengers firmly believe that all Adjusters are volunteers.
p108.s1.b1: Adjusters do not volunteer blindly. The seraphic drafts of ancestry and the projected patterns of life conduct are relayed to Divinington by the reflectivity technique, and the Adjuster volunteers fully apprised of the intimate nature of the mind it will indwell. Three qualifications interest it in particular.

head: Qualification
What the Adjuster asks

2. Spiritual perception

3. Combined powers
Can the two combine to produce strength of character and contribute to the evolution of a soul of survival value?

p108.s1.b3: When more than one Adjuster volunteers, the supervising personalized orders probably select the one best suited. The sex of the creature plays no part in assignment or service. In the short interval before dispatch, the chosen Adjuster is presumably instructed, using a working pattern of the waiting mortal mind, in the most effective plans for approaching the personality.
p108.s2.h: II. Prerequisites of Adjuster Indwelling — The First Moral Choice
p108.s2.b0: Adjusters are not actually assigned until their human subjects make their first moral personality decision. That choice registers in the seventh mind-adjutant, is recorded instantly in the presence of the Master Spirit, and is relayed at once to Divinington. On Urantia Adjusters arrive, on average, just before the sixth birthday—in the present generation, on the 2,134th day of earthly life.
p108.s2.b1: To receive an Adjuster, the mind needs the co-ordinate function of all seven adjutants; it must show the worship outreach and the wisdom to choose between good and evil. Because the Spirit of Truth is present on Urantia, Adjusters have been universally bestowed upon all normal minds of moral status ever since Pentecost.
p108.s2.b3: On worlds before the Spirit of Truth is poured out, the arrival of Adjusters has been observed in connection with several conditions. The list also shows anyone living today where the doors to spiritual growth lie. The fourth and fifth, in particular, are paths anyone can take today.

p108.s3.h: III. Organization and Administration — Ministers Who Have Never Faltered
p108.s3.b0: Adjusters are organized as an independent working unit administered directly from Divinington, and they are uniform throughout the seven superuniverses. Outside Divinington, their complete records exist only at superuniverse headquarters; local universe records contain only an assignment number. Human beings are often known by their Adjusters’ numbers and receive real universe names only after fusion, from the destiny guardian.
p108.s3.b1: An evolutionary world that has received a Paradise bestowal Son has a Personalized Adjuster assigned as planetary supervisor of Adjusters. Local universe inspectors always address the planetary chief of Adjusters when they examine a planet. What Tabamantia, sovereign supervisor of the life-experiment planets, said during his inspection of Urantia shows how the universe regards the Adjusters.
p108.s3.b3: Tabamantia praises the Adjusters for helping to adjust the mistakes and compensate for the shortcomings of all who labor on this confused planet. Before these volunteers, who are apparently under his jurisdiction, he confesses that he all but worships them. This scene of a supervisor bowing before those he supervises shows that the Adjusters’ standing cannot be measured by the hierarchy of universe administration.
p108.s3.b4: The Solitary Messenger adds that his order is the only group of personalized creatures, apart from Personalized Adjusters, uniformly conscious of the presence of many prepersonal entities. For that reason they may be functioning, unconsciously, as universe correlators. The administration of the higher realms is not fully visible even to those who serve within it.
p108.s4.h: IV. Relation to Other Spiritual Influences — Alone, Yet in Harmony
p108.s4.b0: Adjusters are quite alone in their work in the mortal mind. The Father has apparently resigned the direct exercise of personal power to his Creator children, but through the Adjusters he has reserved the right to draw all creatures to himself. Adjusters seem to come and go independently of other spirit influences, yet long observation shows that they work in perfect co-ordination with all the other spirit ministries in the human mind.

p108.s4.b2: Even on a world isolated by rebellion, the Adjusters’ ability to communicate is unaffected. On a planet cut off from outside circuits, as Urantia was after the Caligastia upheaval, the liaison of the Adjusters is, apart from personal messengers, the only means of direct interplanetary communication. However cut off a place may be, the line to God is never severed.
p108.s5.h: V. The Adjuster’s Mission — Heavenly Helpers
p108.s5.b0: The Adjuster receives the admonitions of spiritual intelligences and translates them for the material mind. Truths it cannot transmit now, it faithfully preserves for use in the next stage of existence. Adjusters never lose anything committed to their care, and all seven groups are absolutely dependable.
p108.s5.b3: This section corrects a common expectation about religion. The Adjuster does not try to make life easy; it makes life reasonably difficult so that decisions will be stimulated. In return it confers a sublime peace of mind and a superb tranquillity of spirit.

p108.s5.b5: In sharp conflicts between what is really right and wrong, the Adjuster always takes part in a definite and active way, and the fact that we are unconscious of this activity does not lessen its value. And when a person fails to survive, the guardian angel must be adjudicated, but the Adjuster is never examined, for it works in the manner of Paradise perfection.
p108.s6.h: VI. God in Man — Divine Parent of the Real You
p108.s6.b0: It is a marvel of divine condescension that the perfect Adjusters volunteer to live in beings of animal origin. After the mission of a bestowal Son, the Adjusters truly become the “⟦Q 108:6.2⟧kingdom of heaven within you.⟦/Q⟧” Through them the Father makes his closest approach to sin and evil, and the Adjusters are tormented by sordid and selfish thoughts and thwarted in their work by animal fears.
p108.s6.b1: The “⟦Q 108:6.3⟧image of God⟦/Q⟧” refers not to physical likeness but to the Father’s spirit presence in the Adjuster. The Adjuster duplicates every mental creation with a spiritual counterpart, slowly re-creating us as we really are for resurrection. These counterparts are actually there, even if they seldom rise into consciousness.
p108.s6.b3: The Adjuster is the power of survival that distinguishes us forever from mere animal creatures, the inner spiritual stimulus of thought in contrast with external stimuli coming over the nerves. And how the Adjusters rejoice when they can dispense with symbols and indirection and flash their messages straight to our intellects.
p108.s7.b0: Paper 108 shows how thoroughly prepared the Adjusters are when they come and how faithfully they work. What finally decides the outcome of their ministry is our choice. When the clouds gather overhead, faith should accept the presence of the indwelling Adjuster and look beyond the mists of uncertainty to the shining sun of eternal righteousness.

p108.s7.b2: The next paper, Paper 109, “Relation of Adjusters to Universe Creatures,” explores how Adjusters accumulate experience and the varied relationships they form with the creatures of the universe.
p109.lead: Adjusters too grow by experience: self-acting Adjusters, three series of worlds, the handicaps to indwelling, and true values that are never lost.

p109.foot.text: Presented by a Solitary Messenger of Orvonton

p109.s0.h: Introduction — Adjusters Are Children of the Universe Career
p109.s0.b0: Paper 109 presents the Adjusters not as beings standing still in finished perfection but as beings who grow. Virgin Adjusters gain experience while their mortal creatures grow and develop. Just as a child learns adult skills through play, the indwelling Adjuster gains skill for the next stage by planning and rehearsing the activities of the morontia career in advance.
p109.s0.b2: From this point of view an ordinary day takes on cosmic meaning. What the Adjuster labors at within us has less to do with the passing affairs of planetary existence than with the realities of the universe career. Each of our choices becomes, for the Adjuster, material for rehearsing eternity.
p109.s1.h: I. Development of Adjusters — Experience Has No Substitute
p109.s1.b0: There must be an elaborate plan on Divinington for training virgin Adjusters, and a system for retraining experienced ones. According to Personalized Adjusters, whenever an Adjuster returns because its subject failed to survive, it always undergoes an extended course of training before being sent out again.
p109.s1.b2: Even divine perfection cannot take the place of experience. So Adjusters too must evolve from the lower, inexperienced groups to the higher, more experienced ones. They gain skill and ability from every contact, whether or not their subjects survive, and they are equal partners with the human mind in fostering the evolution of a soul of survival capacity.

p109.s2.h: II. Self-Acting Adjusters — A Functional Classification
p109.s2.b0: Besides the classification by experience—virgin, advanced, and supreme—there is a functional classification. A self-acting Adjuster shows a marked degree of will in matters not involving the personality it indwells and takes part in many activities of the realm. The following six cases qualify.

In brief

2. The balance of spiritual power

3. A solemn betrothal

5. Service during sleep

6. Service in a crisis
It has served in a crisis within a human who was the material complement of a spirit personality

p109.s2.b2: Such Adjusters can communicate with Adjusters in other realms, but only on the level of their mutual work and to preserve the custodial data needed for their ministry; in times of crisis they have even functioned in interplanetary matters. Yet most often they work quietly, as undetected indwellers of the earthly tabernacles they have chosen.
p109.s2.b3: Supreme and self-acting Adjusters can leave the body at will, because Adjusters are not a biologic part of mortal life but a divine superimposition on it. Even so, once they take up their indwelling they very rarely leave, even temporarily. Adjusters that have conquered their entrusted tasks and only await dissolution or translation are called superacting Adjusters.
p109.s3.h: III. Relation of Adjusters to Mortal Types — Three Series of Worlds
p109.s3.b0: The labors of the Mystery Monitors are remarkably uniform, yet they differ according to whether the assignment is one of liaison or of fusion. The text explains this by dividing the worlds into three series.

p109.s3.b3: The type of brain also makes a difference. In three-brained mortals the Adjuster gains far more actual contact during the temporal life than in one- and two-brained types, but after death all proceed in the same way. On two-brained worlds, after a bestowal Son has come, virgin Adjusters are seldom assigned to persons of unquestioned survival capacity.
p109.s3.b4: Among the early races of Urantia there were those wholly lacking Adjuster capacity, those who promptly received Adjusters at the age of moral responsibility, and a borderline group who could receive them only on personal petition. Even virgin Adjusters that served beings virtually disqualified for survival gained valuable preliminary experience and became better qualified for higher minds on other worlds.
p109.s4.h: IV. Adjusters and Human Personality — A Real Potential of Civilization
p109.s4.b0: Animals share feelings, but they do not communicate ideas and ideals. High intellectual intercourse and spiritual communion between people are made possible with the Adjusters’ help, and evolutionary beings who develop speech are on the highroad to receiving Adjusters. Adjusters are not personality, but they come from the source of personality, and their presence enhances the quality of human personality.
p109.s4.b1: Many of the great intellectual and spiritual leaders of Urantia exerted their influence chiefly because of the superiority and previous experience of their indwelling Adjusters. If the Adjusters were withdrawn, this world would slowly return to many of the practices of primitive times.
p109.s4.b3: The author testifies that an Adjuster which had previously indwelt fifteen minds in Orvonton is now in a person on Urantia. What others lost by refusing survival, this person and the whole world now gain. Adjusters, however, are seldom given two indwellings on the same planet, and none now serving on Urantia has been here before.
p109.s5.h: V. Material Handicaps to Adjuster Indwelling — The Art of Serving Two Masters
p109.s5.b0: When the mind flows freely in the controlled channels of creative imagination, and sometimes during sleep, the Adjuster can arrest the mental currents and divert the idea procession, effecting deep spiritual transformations in the superconsciousness. But unsteady mental attitudes often thwart its plans.

p109.s5.b4: The great problem of life is adjusting the tendencies we inherit from our ancestors to the spiritual urges initiated by the Adjuster. Many grow weary and falter under this strain, but heredity only slows the rate of personality conquest; it does not prevent the final completion of the ascendant adventure. This is a clear comfort to anyone discouraged by an inborn temperament.
p109.s6.h: VI. The Persistence of True Values — No Experience Is Wasted
p109.s6.b0: Adjusters never fail, and nothing worth surviving is ever lost. Even when a mortal rejects survival, the worth-while elements of that life are carried by the Adjuster to a higher mind on another world. An Adjuster that is personalized after repeated failures to attain fusion becomes a composite assembly of the survival traits of all its former hosts.
p109.s6.b2: At the center of this section stands the Personalized Adjuster of Michael of Nebadon. This Monitor guided Michael step by step when he lived as Joshua ben Joseph, and before that had served with Machiventa Melchizedek in the days of Abraham. Today he directs the activities of Adjusters in Nebadon.
p109.s6.b4: This Adjuster still reflects the prebaptismal humanity of Joshua ben Joseph—a living transcript of the values created in the humble circumstances of a commonplace life. The permanent values entrusted to an Adjuster are either bestowed on a mind of future indwelling or held in trust for future service with the Architects of the Master Universe.
p109.s7.h: VII. Destiny of Personalized Adjusters — Omnipersonal Beings
p109.s7.b0: Father fragments of the Adjuster type seem to attain personality only through service-ministry to a personal being. Personalized Adjusters make their home on Divinington, where they instruct their prepersonal associates, and they serve as the powerful executives of the Architects of the Master Universe. They alone are before personality, are personality, and are after personality.
p109.s7.b1: When the emergency regency began on Urantia, three Personalized Adjusters appeared, uncalled, the instant the Most High regent assumed authority. He assigned them no duties, yet they were among the most active beings then serving on this world. No one dares to predict what their future missions may be.
p109.s8.b0: Paper 109 comes down to two points. Because experience has no substitute, every day we live is material for growth, both for the Adjuster and for us. And true values are never lost. As Jesus’ Adjuster shows, consecration to the Father’s will opens the way to all such growth.

p109.s8.b2: The next paper, Paper 110, “Relation of Adjusters to Individual Mortals,” moves from the whole universe to the single person, examining how we co-operate with the Adjuster and the seven psychic circles.
p110.lead: The Adjuster at work in one person: a partner who respects our will, the ways of co-operation, how to tell it from conscience and dreams, the seven psychic circles, and the attainment of immortality.

p110.foot.text: Presented by a Solitary Messenger of Orvonton

p110.s0.h: Introduction — The Most Divine Affection in All Creation
p110.s0.b0: Papers 107 to 109 dealt with the nature and mission of the Adjusters and their relation to universe creatures; Paper 110 narrows its focus to the single person. The author opens by observing that giving freedom to imperfect beings brings inevitable tragedy, and that it is the nature of perfect Deity to share those sufferings in loving companionship.
p110.s0.b2: The love of the Sons for the races is superb, but the devotion of an Adjuster to the individual is sublime and divinely Fatherlike. The Paradise Father seems to have reserved this form of personal contact with his individual creatures as his own exclusive Creator prerogative.
p110.s1.h: I. Indwelling the Mortal Mind — A Guest Whose Tabernacle Is the Body
p110.s1.b0: The Adjuster indwells not the brain, a physical organ, but the mortal mind. Indirectly and unrecognized, it is constantly communicating with us, especially when the mind makes worshipful contact with spirit in the superconsciousness. The author repeatedly appeals to his readers to love their Adjusters more and co-operate with them more fully.
p110.s1.b1: The Adjuster’s chief concern is our eternal future, but it is not indifferent to our temporal welfare. It is delighted to contribute to our health, happiness, and true prosperity, so long as these do not harm our eternal progress. Yet it is passive about purely temporal matters and divinely active in all that concerns eternity.

p110.s1.b4: If this courtship is faithfully lived, there will at last follow a never-ending blending of identity. That oneness is so complete that even the most experienced personalities can never distinguish the fusion partners as separate identities. Small acts of faithfulness today prepare for that eternal union.
p110.s2.h: II. Adjusters and Human Will — A Plan Foreordained but Never Forced
p110.s2.b0: The Adjuster comes bearing an ideal life plan determined beforehand on Divinington. Yet no one is obliged to accept it. We are subjects of predestination, but it is not foreordained that we must accept that predestination. The Adjuster respects the sovereignty of personality and is always subservient to our will.
p110.s2.b2: The Adjuster does not control our thinking as such. Influencing human thought directly is our exclusive personality prerogative; the Adjuster improves and co-ordinates our thinking processes and, above all, builds morontia transcripts of our careers. When our minds see eye to eye with the Adjuster’s and our will carries out the decision, the Adjuster’s prepersonal will attains personality expression through our decision.
p110.s2.b3: Two realities, then, are centered in the human mind circuits: a mortal self evolved from the plans of the Life Carriers, and an immortal gift from Divinington. To the extent that their identity is realized, we approach the morontia order of existence. The key is a will, human in origin, that is becoming divine through identifying the human mind with the mindedness of God.

p110.s3.h: III. Co-operation with the Adjuster — Devotion That Goes with Joy
p110.s3.b0: The Adjuster’s success depends less on the theories of our beliefs than on our decisions, determinations, and steadfast faith. The Adjuster itself never fails; we speak of success or failure only in terms of human survival. The author regrets that so many spend so much time on the trifles of living while overlooking the essential work of co-operating with the Adjuster.
p110.s3.b2: Confusion and discouragement do not necessarily mean resistance. Neither ignorance nor confusional doubts can prevent survival; only conscious resistance to the Adjuster’s leading can. Co-operation is not a particularly conscious process; it consists of motives, decisions, and supreme desires, and it can be consciously augmented in four ways.

p110.s4.h: IV–V. The Adjuster’s Work in the Mind; Erroneous Concepts of Adjuster Guidance
p110.s4.b0: The Adjuster is in full touch with the wisdom and truth of the universes, but for lack of commonness of nature it can transmit little of it to the mortal mind. A thought that arrives suddenly may at times be the Adjuster’s work, but far more often it is an idea that has been forming in the subconscious. The Adjuster’s revelations appear not through the subconscious but through the superconscious.
p110.s4.b2: Even when the Adjuster manages to flash a gleam of new truth, it often precipitates a convulsion of fanaticism or an intellectual upheaval. Many a new religion and strange “ism” has arisen from garbled Adjuster communications. So the paper draws clear distinctions about what not to take for the Adjuster’s voice.

p110.s4.b5: The human being through whom this revelation came teaches the same lesson. He had a highly experienced Adjuster but was almost completely indifferent to its outward manifestations, and that very indifference gave the Adjuster a wide scope of activity. Living calmly is a healthier path than chasing spiritual phenomena.
p110.s5.h: VI. The Seven Psychic Circles — A Ladder of Balanced Growth
p110.s5.b0: The sum of personality realization on a material world lies in the successive conquest of the seven psychic circles. Entering the seventh circle marks the beginning of true human personality function; completing the first marks relative maturity. The circles are neither purely intellectual nor wholly morontial, and passing through them requires the harmonious functioning of the whole personality.
p110.s5.b1: When intellect outpaces spirituality, communication with the Adjuster becomes difficult and dangerous; overspiritual development, on the other hand, leads to fanatical interpretations of spirit leading. When body, mind, and spirit grow in harmony, the most light and truth can be imparted with the least risk. And not only the weight of a decision matters, but also the number of decisions and their persistent repetition, which make the response a sure habit.

p110.s5.b3: Circle attainment is only relatively related to God-consciousness. A seventh circler can be almost as truly God-knowing and sonship-conscious as a first circler, but is far less conscious of experiential relation to the Supreme Being—universe citizenship—which grows not by faith alone but through the completion of decisions.

p110.s6.h: VII. The Attainment of Immortality — The Day the Two Become One
p110.s6.b0: Attaining the seven circles is not the same as fusion. Fusion comes when the mortal will is finally and completely attuned to the will of God as it resides in the Adjuster. When fusion occurs during physical life, the material body is instantly consumed, and those watching would see the mortal disappear “⟦Q 110:7.2⟧in chariots of fire.⟦/Q⟧”
p110.s6.b1: After fusion, all experience and all values become the possession of both, so that the two are actually one entity. But for the vast majority of Urantians the Adjuster must patiently await the deliverance of death. So few mortals are real thinkers, and the ear of the human mind is almost deaf to the spiritual pleas the Adjuster translates.
p110.s6.b2: Adjusters rejoice to contact the mortal mind, but because of animal resistance they must endure long years of silent sojourn. Those below the third and second circles seldom hear the Adjuster’s direct voice except in moments of supreme desire and after a supreme decision. Put the other way around, lofty desire and decision open the door to hearing that voice.
p110.s6.b3: At the end of the paper, the author shares the plea of a self-acting Adjuster to its human partner in the reserve corps of destiny: to co-operate more faithfully, to endure its tasks more cheerfully, and not to disappoint it.
p110.s7.b0: Paper 110 invites us to see the Adjuster not only as an object of awe but as our closest companion, waiting for our co-operation. Co-operation is not a mystical experience; it is made of everyday motives, decisions, and repetition. The Adjuster’s voice is always within us, and it grows clearer in moments of supreme desire and decision.

p110.s7.b2: The next paper, Paper 111, “The Adjuster and the Soul,” examines the soul that is born and grows between the Adjuster and the mind—the nature and growth of the morontia self.
p111.lead: Mind is the ship, the Adjuster the pilot, the will the captain: the soul born of the relationship between mind and spirit, the creative inner life, and the consecration of the will.

p111.foot.text: Presented by a Solitary Messenger of Orvonton

p111.s0.h: Introduction — An Ancient Intuition, a New Revelation
p111.s0.b0: Paper 111, the last in the series on Adjusters, deals with the **soul** that grows between the Adjuster and the mind. The author first states plainly that, because of the Adjuster’s presence, neither science nor philosophy can ever satisfactorily comprehend the evolving soul. The soul is the child of the universe and can really be known only through cosmic insight and spiritual discovery.
p111.s0.b1: The idea of a soul and of an indwelling spirit is not new. People have long felt that something is growing within human nature that will endure beyond the brief span of temporal life. The savage associated the soul with blood, breath, and shadows, and various civilizations tried in their own ways to distinguish the indwelling spirit from the soul.

p111.s0.b4: One Egyptian ruler confessed that he feared to transgress the guidance of the ka within his heart and prospered greatly because of it. At first only kings were thought to have kas, but later all righteous men were believed to possess them. Such intuitions show that the soil for receiving the revelation of the Adjuster and the soul had long been prepared in humankind.
p111.s1.h: I. The Mind Arena of Choice — Ship, Pilot, and Captain
p111.s1.b0: The Adjuster’s work is spiritual, yet it must be done on an intellectual foundation. Mind is the human soil from which the Adjuster, with the co-operation of the personality, evolves the soul. Our bodies were provided by material evolution and our Adjusters were given by the Father, but mind alone has been placed in our hands, subject to our decisions.
p111.s1.b2: What decides survival is not our present state but our direction. It is not so much what the mind comprehends as what it desires to comprehend, not so much being conscious of God as yearning for God, that leads to ascension. Mind is a cosmic instrument on which we can play either the discords of destruction or the melodies of God identification.
p111.s1.b3: The Adjuster is impervious to evil and incapable of sin. But the mind can be twisted and made ugly by a self-seeking will, or made noble and beautiful by a God-knowing will. Until the evolving mind becomes wholly mechanized or entirely spiritualized, its stability and peace depend on personality choice and spirit identification.
p111.s1.b5: We do not hand our will over to the Adjuster like slaves. We actively choose to follow its leading when that leading differs from our natural desires. To the Adjuster the human will is supreme; it manipulates the mind but never dominates it against our will. The text sums up this relationship with the image of a voyage.

p111.s2.h: II. Nature of the Soul — Neither Material nor Spiritual, but Morontial
p111.s2.b0: The material mind is the cosmic loom carrying the morontia fabrics, on which the Adjuster threads the spirit patterns of a character of enduring values. The character so woven is the surviving soul, a potential finaliter. The soul is not a blend of the qualities of mind and spirit but an entirely new and unique universe value.

p111.s2.b2: The midway creatures have long called this soul the mid-mind, because it lies between the lower, material mind and the higher, cosmic mind. Its potential arises where the creature’s urge to know God meets the Creator’s urge to know man. The soul is the joint offspring of a mind dominated by a will that craves to know God, working in liaison with the Adjuster.
p111.s3.h: III. The Evolving Soul — An Education, Not a Test
p111.s3.b0: The mistakes of the mind and errors of conduct can delay the soul’s evolution, but they cannot inhibit it once the Adjuster has begun it with the consent of the will. Until fusion, however, we remain free to forsake the Father’s will. Fusion is the sign that we have chosen, eternally and unreservedly, to do the Father’s will.
p111.s3.b1: During life the power of decision resides in the circuits of the material mind, but as we grow, the self becomes more and more identified with the emerging soul. After resurrection the personality is completely identified with the morontia self, so the soul is the embryo of our future personality identity.
p111.s3.b2: Both the human mind and the Adjuster are conscious of the soul—the Adjuster fully, the mind partially—and the soul becomes increasingly conscious of both as it grows. At first wholly morontial, the soul eventually ascends to true spirit levels, capable of fusion with the Adjuster.
p111.s3.b4: Mind knows quantity, reality, and meanings, but quality—values—is felt. As the soul becomes permeated by truth, beauty, and goodness, it becomes indestructible.
p111.s4.h: IV. The Inner Life — The Truly Creative Place
p111.s4.b0: Meanings arise from the combination of recognition and understanding, and meanings and values are perceived only in the inner realm. All the advances of true civilization are therefore born in the inner world. When most of a generation’s youth devote themselves only to the materialistic pursuits of the outer world, civilization is in jeopardy.
p111.s4.b1: Personality is creative, but it functions creatively only in the inner life of the individual. Just as snow crystals are all hexagonal yet no two are alike, personality follows types but is always unique. The higher concepts that will build a more enduring civilization are found only in the higher levels of the superconscious mind, where it touches the spirit realm.

p111.s4.b3: Inner creativity brings responsibility. An imagination whose stage is crowded with prejudice, hate, fear, and resentment cannot produce worthy children. The text diagnoses the cause of poverty, war, and racial hatred in nations led by men rich in ideas but poverty-stricken in ideals. Evil is creativity turned toward disintegration, and all conflict is a kind of civil war in the personality.
p111.s5.h: V. The Consecration of Choice — Not Surrender but Expansion
p111.s5.b0: Doing the will of God is simply showing our willingness to share our inner life with God. Sharing is Godlike. And before we ever trust ourselves to God, God has first trusted a part of himself to us, consenting to live in us subject to the human will.
p111.s5.b1: Choosing the Father’s will is therefore not a surrender of the will but a consecration and an expansion of it. That choice consists less in the negation “⟦Q 111:5.6⟧Not my will but yours be done⟦/Q⟧” than in a positive affirmation.
p111.s6.h: VI–VII. The Human Paradox; The Adjuster’s Problem — Security amid Uncertainty
p111.s6.b0: Man is part of nature yet able to transcend it; finite, yet indwelt by a spark of infinity. The courage that conquers nature is a courage that might yield to self-pride. Finiteness itself is not evil; evil and sin arise from the misuse and perversion of the finite. Amid this insecurity, only living faith can sustain us.
p111.s6.b1: Of all the dangers, pride is the greatest. Reasonable self-confidence is not to be deplored, but egotism is suicidal. Whether in an individual or a nation, pride is deceitful, intoxicating, and sin-breeding.
p111.s6.b2: The paper does not set knowledge against faith. Science is the source of facts, and the mind cannot operate without facts. To apply the truth we find in inner experience to the practical demands of daily life, we need a clear knowledge of facts. Only when we discover divine law and divine love and unify them do we begin to appreciate the fullness of the First Source and Center.
p111.s6.b4: The Adjuster cannot stop the struggle of life or lessen its hardships. But if we allow it, it will fight with us and for us, showing us the real motive and eternal purpose behind all our toil. The author closes with the statement of a guardian seraphim: despite the unending conflict between her subject’s two natures, with the Adjuster’s help that soul ascended to the judgment halls of the mansion worlds.

p111.s7.b2: The next paper, Paper 112, “Personality Survival,” goes on to show how the soul and personality that have grown in this way survive beyond death.
p112.lead: Personality, changeless amid change: the nature of the self, three kinds of death, repersonalization, and the path of survival that leads to Adjuster fusion.

p112.foot.text: Presented by a Solitary Messenger of Orvonton

p112.s0.h: Introduction — What Does Not Change amid Change
p112.s0.b0: In Paper 112 a Solitary Messenger of Orvonton explains how personality survives death. Urantia is the starting point of the ascending career, the place where we and our Thought Adjusters are joined in temporary union. Those who sincerely run the race of time will be eternally united with their Adjusters and will discover that the present mortal state was only the vestibule of real life.
p112.s0.b1: One axis runs through this whole long journey. Body, mind, and soul change constantly, yet amid all those changes one part of us remains absolutely unaltered. The author calls it **personality**, and rather than attempt a definition, he begins by recounting what is known about it.

p112.s1.h: I. Personality and Reality — A System, Not an Aggregation
p112.s1.b0: Personality is a potentially eternal endowment, designed to function from the lowly finite to the borders of the absolute. Finite personality operates in three dimensions—length, depth, and breadth—and the personality of Urantia mortals has a potential of seven dimensions in all. These dimensions are greatly enhanced on the morontia level.

p112.s1.b2: Life is a process taking place between the organism and its environment, and personality gives that relationship the value of identity and the meaning of continuity. So stimulus and response are not a mere mechanical process. Nor can personality function well in isolation, for man is a social creature dominated by the craving to belong.
p112.s1.b4: The author distinguishes relationships from systems. In aggregations parts are added; in systems parts are arranged and gain positional value. In a good system every factor is in its place; in a bad one something is missing or displaced. In the human being it is personality that unifies all these activities.
p112.s2.h: II. The Self — The One Who Observes the Observation
p112.s2.b0: In studying the self, an order is worth remembering: physical systems are subordinate, intellectual systems are co-ordinate, personality is superordinate, and the indwelling spirit is potentially directive. And the fact of life comes first, its interpretation later. The child first lives and only afterward thinks about his living.
p112.s2.b1: The very possession of personality marks a person as a spiritual being. Even the materialist’s ability to deny supermaterial reality shows that spirit synthesis is at work in his mind. Science observes the material world, philosophy observes that observation, and religion experientially realizes the reality of the one who observes all this observing.
p112.s2.b4: The purpose of cosmic evolution is increasing spirit dominance—the unification of personality through volitional response to the Adjuster’s leading. The author calls this “⟦Q 112:2.15⟧the evolution of dominance⟦/Q⟧.” Before becoming finaliters, ascending personalities have the God-seeking experience; afterward, they have the God-revealing experience of showing God to those still seeking him. The seeker at last becomes the one who reveals.
p112.s2.b5: A self that can survive does not arise by itself. The transfer of the seat of identity from the material body to the immortal morontia soul is effected by the sincerity, persistence, and steadfastness of our God-seeking decisions. In the end, the key to survival lies in the quality of the decisions we make today.
p112.s3.h: III–IV. The Phenomenon of Death; Adjusters after Death
p112.s3.b0: Most people recognize only one kind of death, the cessation of physical life, but with regard to personality survival there are really three. In every case the Adjuster leaves the person for Divinington and is registered out by the same number that recorded its entry into the domains of time.

p112.s3.b2: After death the body returns to the elemental world, but two nonmaterial factors persist. The Adjuster goes to Divinington carrying the memory transcription of the mortal career, and the morontia soul remains in the keeping of the destiny guardian. At death the Adjuster loses personality but not identity, while the human loses identity but not personality.
p112.s3.b4: If a person has reached the third circle or higher, has been assigned a personal guardian, and the records of Adjuster and seraphim agree, the soul goes immediately to the resurrection halls of the mansion worlds. Others await a group repersonalization at the end of the dispensation, and meanwhile their Adjusters choose a temporary assignment, such as the schools of Divinington.
p112.s4.h: V. Survival of the Human Self — One True Opportunity
p112.s4.b0: Personality comes from the Father and is therefore eternal, but with regard to identity it is a conditioned eternal reality. An energy system must continue; it has no choice. Man, however, has everything to do with determining his own destiny. The Adjuster is the path to Paradise, but walking that path is a matter of free choice.
p112.s4.b1: The universe governments handle this choice with great generosity. Those who, through no fault of their own, could not master the circles on earth because of the accidents of time are given extended probation, and when there is doubt about advancing someone, the decision always favors the individual. This does not mean a second chance; it means that everyone enjoys one true opportunity to make a final choice.
p112.s4.b3: What survives death is the **soul**, the conjoint child of the human you and the divine Adjuster. This soul waits, wholly unconscious, in the keeping of the destiny guardian until repersonalization, which takes place in the life-assembly chambers of the resurrection halls.

p112.s4.b5: On awakening, much of earthly life may at first seem like a vague and hazy dream. Memories with no spiritual meaning perish with the material brain, but memories of relationships between persons have cosmic value and persist. On the mansion worlds we will recognize our former associates and be remembered by them.
p112.s5.h: VI. The Morontia Self — Outside and Inside Becoming One
p112.s5.b1: In physical life a person can be outwardly beautiful though inwardly unlovely. In the morontia life, however, the form varies directly with the inner nature, and the nearer one comes to the spirit level, the closer outward form and inner nature approach complete identity. The character we cultivate now will become our face in the future.
p112.s5.b2: When the material mind is gone, the morontia soul cannot retain self-consciousness without the Adjuster. The memory patterns in the soul come alive when the returning Adjuster energizes them. Leaving the native planet, the ascender leaves the adjutant ministry behind and depends on morontia intellect; leaving the local universe, he reaches the spiritual level.
p112.s5.b3: The persistence of memory is proof that the original self has been retained. That is why those who ascend without Adjusters spend considerable time, with the help of seraphic instructors, rebuilding memory and recapturing the meanings and values of their former lives. That memory is treated with such importance also means that the days we live on earth are not lived in vain.
p112.s6.h: VII. Adjuster Fusion — The Eternal Partnership of God and Man
p112.s6.b0: Fusion with the Adjuster imparts to personality eternal actualities that were previously only potential. It usually takes place while the ascender is resident in the local system, and it never occurs until the superuniverse has pronounced the person’s choice final and irrevocable. Once fusion is effected, there is no further danger to that personality’s eternal career.

p112.s6.b2: Has the Adjuster won personality, or has the human acquired immortality? The author answers: neither. Together they have achieved a new ascending personality. Because the human was the first to enjoy personality, the human outranks the Adjuster in matters of personality recognition, and the Paradise headquarters of this union is Ascendington, not Divinington.
p112.s6.b4: With this fusion the Father completes his promise of the gift of himself to his material creatures. The author believes that those who reach the Corps of the Finality will one day serve as understanding and sympathetic administrators in the universes of the first outer space level.
p112.s7.b0: Paper 112 teaches us to see death not as an end but as a transition. Our frame is dust, but if we truly desire it, the heritage of the ages is ours. What decides the path is not some grand experience but the sincerity of our decision to seek God and the relationships we build in loving people.

p112.s7.b3: The next paper, Paper 113, “Seraphic Guardians of Destiny,” looks closely at the seraphim who kept the soul in this paper—the guardians of destiny—and how they work in a human life.
p113.lead: Angels who stand guard beside us without ever invading our will: assignment by circles, the co-ordination of spirit influences, death and resurrection, and companionship all the way to Paradise.

p113.foot.text: Presented by the Chief of Seraphim stationed on Urantia

p113.s0.h: Introduction — Guardian Angels Are No Myth
p113.s0.b0: The preceding papers told of the Ministering Spirits of Time and the Messenger Hosts of Space. Paper 113 turns to the seraphim devoted to the care of individual mortals, the **guardians of destiny**. Presented by the Chief of Seraphim stationed on Urantia, it tells us that the traditional angels of heaven really do live near us and do much for us. In past ages these guardians were about the only group of angels this world recognized at all.
p113.s0.b2: Jesus himself acknowledged this. Speaking of the children of the heavenly kingdom, he warned his hearers not to despise even one of these little ones, because their angels always look upon the presence of the Father’s spirit. Whoever reads this paper comes to see afresh that no human life is a road walked alone.
p113.s1.h: I. The Guardian Angels — Care That Changes with the Circles
p113.s1.b0: Seraphim were at first assigned to the separate races of Urantia, but since the bestowal of Michael they are assigned according to human intelligence, spirituality, and destiny. The subnormal minded have one company of seraphim, with a battalion of cherubim, to see that justice and mercy are extended to them. The supernormal minded, and anyone enrolled in a reserve corps of destiny, are at once given personal seraphim.
p113.s1.b1: The ordinary person starts out in the seventh circle and journeys inward through the task of self-understanding, self-conquest, and self-mastery. The farther inward one moves, the fewer the people each angel is asked to watch over.

p113.s2.b1: On Urantia the first mortal to receive a personal guardian was Rantowoc, a wise man of the red race of long ago. Seraphim always volunteer for this service, and only those of long service, experienced and tested, are given it. The text offers an example: when a certain mortal was admitted to the reserve corps of destiny, more than one hundred qualified seraphim sought the assignment.
p113.s2.b2: Guardians serve in pairs, and one of the two is always on duty. The complement of being becomes the recorder; these are the **recording angels** of the evolutionary worlds. Angels share most of our emotions, but one of them they find hard to grasp.
p113.s2.b4: The angels wonder why we let our higher intellectual powers, and even our religious faith, be ruled by fear. The passage puts a quiet question to us: with a guardian always at our side, why do we live so captive to anxiety?
p113.s2.b5: Every seraphim has a name, yet in world service they are often known by planetary numbers. The paper even gives the long army, legion, and host numbers of the guardian of the human subject used in this revelation. When their wards fail to survive, guardians may serve again and again on the same planet, and in the process they grow attached to particular worlds and their peoples. An angel’s affection is not an abstract concern but the real warmth one feels for those one has long lived beside.
p113.s3.h: III. Relation to Other Spirit Influences — A Personal Co-ordinator
p113.s3.b0: One of the most important things a guardian does is to co-ordinate, in a personal way, the many impersonal spirit influences that touch the human mind and soul. Nonpersonal spirits find it exceedingly difficult to make direct contact with minds so material and so discretely personal. The seraphim first unifies the varied ministries of the Infinite Spirit and then correlates them with the spirit presences of the Father and the Son.

p113.s3.b3: This is why the seraphim becomes the custodian of the mind patterns, memory formulas, and soul realities of the survivor between death and resurrection. How so humble an angel manages such complex work, the author frankly admits, is not really known; it is conjectured that the unrevealed working of the Supreme Being makes it possible.
p113.s4.h: IV–V. Seraphic Domains of Action; Seraphic Ministry to Mortals — From the Outside Inward
p113.s4.b0: Seraphim stimulate the mind to make circle-making decisions. Yet they do not work as the Adjuster does, from within through the soul; they work from the outside inward, through the social, ethical, and moral environment. The impulse of worship comes largely from the adjutants and the Adjuster, but the urge to pray very often arises from seraphic influence.

p113.s4.b3: Although there seems to be no communication between Adjuster and seraphim, the two always work in exquisite accord. The personal ministry of the seraphim, the God presence of the Adjuster, the circuit of the Holy Spirit, and the Son-consciousness of the Spirit of Truth come from different sources and levels, yet all are integrated in the evolving presence of the Supreme Being. Heaven’s help to one person is manifold, but it never works at cross-purposes.
p113.s4.b4: Angelic guidance leads, if anything, up the rugged hills of moral choosing and spiritual progress. And the angels never touch human freedom. No universe personality has the authority to curtail a person’s prerogative of choice.
p113.s4.b6: Seraphim do not respond directly to our prayers or our passing whims; they carry out the mandates of their superiors. We chart our own course, and the angels help us make the best possible use of it. They seldom step into the routine of daily life except in emergencies, and material intervention is very rare.
p113.s5.h: VI. Guardian Angels after Death — Trustees of the Soul
p113.s5.b0: At death, everything that constitutes the real you, except the identity represented by the departing Adjuster, is entrusted to the guardian. The guardian reports up the chain of command and then goes to the first mansion world to await the awakening of her former ward. In the resurrection halls the Adjuster, the seraphim, and the new morontia form work together, and the personality is reassembled.
p113.s5.b2: If the ward fails to survive, the guardian is absolved of blame before the tribunals of the archangels and moves on to a new assignment. At the dispensational roll call the seraphim answer on behalf of nonsurvivors but the Adjusters do not; this is the “⟦Q 113:6.8⟧resurrection of the unjust,⟦/Q⟧” the formal recognition that creature existence has ceased.
p113.s5.b3: When those of the lower circles are raised together at the end of an age, it is their group guardians who reassemble them in the resurrection halls. Over age after age such guardians may hold in trust thousands upon thousands of sleeping survivors. Meanwhile the Satania guardians who went astray in the Lucifer rebellion, though many sincerely repented, are detained on Jerusem until the final adjudication, and the souls they had held are kept safe by volunteer seconaphim.
p113.s6.h: VII. Seraphim and the Ascendant Career — Companions to Paradise
p113.s6.b0: The first awakening on the mansion world is an epoch in the ascending career. There, for the first time, we actually see the angelic companions who were always near us on earth, and become truly conscious of the presence of the Adjuster who indwelt us.
p113.s6.b2: On the morontia spheres the two guardian seraphim become our open companions, helping us progress while they themselves study in the extension schools of the mansion worlds. Because mankind was created a little lower than the simplest angels, our first morontia assignment is to serve as assistants to the seraphim. The one who was cared for now becomes a fellow worker.

p113.s6.b4: In Havona, some guardians follow their pilgrims through the central universe; others bid a temporary farewell and achieve the circles of Seraphington on their own. They will be waiting on the shores of Paradise when their mortal associates awaken from the last transit sleep of time. Whether or not man and angel serve together again, the bond between them lasts forever.
p113.s6.b5: For seraphim, the surest way to the Paradise Deities is to guide a soul of evolutionary origin to the portals of Paradise. That is why only destiny guardians are mustered into the mortal Corps of the Finality, and some of our angelic associates in time become our finaliter associates in eternity.
p113.s7.b0: Paper 113 pictures angelic care not as mysterious intervention but as companionship that respects human dignity. Angels never take the place of our will; they help us make the best use of the path we choose. Our part, then, is to stop being driven by fear and to decide our way, step by step, toward the inner circles.
